conditions.label: Is Pregnant
conditions.description: is pregnant and at least {param1}% through the pregnancy

conditions.label: Is Ovulating
conditions.description: is ovulating and at her most fertile

conditions.label: Menstrual Cycle Phase
conditions.description: is in the {param1} part of her monthly cycle

conditions.label: Unborn Baby Health
conditions.description: is pregnant and the unborn baby is at least {param1}% healthy

conditions.label: Times Given Birth
conditions.description: has given birth at least {param1} time(s) before

conditions.label: Pregnancy Stage (Trimester)
conditions.description: is in the {param1} stage of pregnancy

conditions.label: Father of Current Baby Nearby
conditions.description: the father of the child she is carrying is within {param1} m

conditions.label: Father of a Past Child Nearby
conditions.description: a father of one of her already-born children is within {param1} m

conditions.label: Has Sperm Inside
conditions.description: has fertile sperm inside her right now, viable for conception

effects.label: Start Ovulation
effects.description: Makes the actor begin ovulating (no effect if she is already pregnant).

effects.label: Force Multiple Babies (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, guarantees a multiple pregnancy — raises the litter to {param1} babies if fewer were conceived. Never lowers a larger litter.

effects.label: Chance of More Babies (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, she carries at least {param1} — each further baby then has a {param2}% chance to be added on top, rolled once when she conceives (a high chance can cascade into a large litter). Never lowers a larger natural litter.

effects.label: Prevent Conception (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, the actor cannot conceive. Her natural fertility is restored when the tattoo is removed.

effects.label: Suppress PMS (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, suppresses the actor's PMS. Restored on removal.

effects.label: Remove All Contraception
effects.description: Instantly strips all contraceptive protection from the actor.

effects.label: Allow Conception This Cycle
effects.description: Re-enables conception for the actor this cycle (does not force pregnancy on its own).

effects.label: Restore Automatic Cycle
effects.description: Clears all manual fertility and PMS overrides, returning the actor to Beeing Female's automatic behavior.

effects.label: Conceive From Existing Sperm
effects.description: Forces conception from sperm already present (no effect if already pregnant or no sperm is present).

effects.label: Induce Labor (Give Birth)
effects.description: Induces birth if the actor is in her third trimester.

effects.label: Restart Menstrual Cycle
effects.description: Restarts the actor's menstrual cycle from the follicular phase (no effect while pregnant).

effects.label: End Pregnancy (Miscarry)
effects.description: Terminates an active pregnancy (miscarriage). No effect if not pregnant.

effects.label: Heal Unborn Baby (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, heals the unborn baby by {param1} health each hour — a protective pregnancy tattoo.

effects.label: Maintain Contraception (while worn)
effects.description: While worn, tops up contraception by {param1}% each hour so protection never lapses.

effects.label: Wash Out Sperm
effects.description: Instantly washes out {param1}% of the sperm currently inside the actor.

effects.label: Damage Unborn Baby
effects.description: Instantly damages the unborn baby by {param1} health. No effect if not pregnant.
